candidates.title: Kenyan advocacy for close-in-age 'Romeo & Juliet' laws: reform defilement sentencing so near-peer teen relationships aren't punished like predatory cases
candidates.snippet: Sholla Ard (@sholard_mancity): A public appeal to Parliament to amend Kenyan law or introduce 'Romeo & Juliet laws'. Argues that a young person can currently face 20+ years in prison for a relationship with someone just 1-3 years younger (e.g. an 18-19-year-old with a 16-17-year-old who are peers, sometimes classmates), treated the same as actual predatory cases, and that many jurisdictions handle small age-gap cases differently (e.g. community service) because not every case is exploitative.
